def log_response(response: AgentOutput, registry=None, logger=None, agent=None) -> None:
    """Utility function to log the model's response."""
    if logger is None:
        logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    prefix = f'[Agent {getattr(agent, "id", "")}] ' if agent else ''
    if response.current_state.thinking:
        logger.debug(f'{prefix}💡 Thinking:\n{response.current_state.thinking}')
    eval_goal = response.current_state.evaluation_previous_goal
    if eval_goal:
        if 'success' in eval_goal.lower():
            emoji = '👍'
            logger.info(f'{prefix}  \033[32m{emoji} Eval: {eval_goal}\033[0m')
        elif 'failure' in eval_goal.lower():
            emoji = '⚠️'
            logger.info(f'{prefix}  \033[31m{emoji} Eval: {eval_goal}\033[0m')
        else:
            emoji = '❔'
            logger.info(f'{prefix}  {emoji} Eval: {eval_goal}')
    if response.current_state.memory:
        logger.info(f'{prefix}  🧠 Memory: {response.current_state.memory}')
    next_goal = response.current_state.next_goal
    if next_goal:
        logger.info(f'{prefix}  \033[34m🎯 Next goal: {next_goal}\033[0m')
